ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B3-1,
Community Shopping, District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 7-N in the
area bound by:

West Diversey Avenue, the alley next east of and parallel to North Oak Park Avenue; a
line 86.5 feet south of and parallel to West Diversey Avenue; and, North Oak Park
Avenue

to those of a RS2, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House), District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

aig

Gilbert Villegas
Alderman, 36" Ward

Common Address:
2753-59 North Oak Park Avenue
